cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28.3.0)
set(CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "/workspaces/hack2-fall26_Team_15/buils/_deps/raylib-src/cmake;/workspaces/hack2-fall26_Team_15/buils/_deps/raylib-src/src/external/glfw/CMake/modules")
project(CMAKE_TRY_COMPILE C)
set(CMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE 1)
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "-fno-strict-aliasing -Werror=implicit-function-declaration -Werror=pointer-arith ")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} ${COMPILE_DEFINITIONS}")
set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "-g")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "")
set(CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS "${CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS} ${EXE_LINKER_FLAGS}")
include_directories(${INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES})
set(CMAKE_SUPPRESS_REGENERATION 1)
link_directories(${LINK_DIRECTORIES})
cmake_policy(SET CMP0065 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0083 NEW)
cmake_policy(SET CMP0155 NEW)
include("${CMAKE_ROOT}/Modules/Internal/HeaderpadWorkaround.cmake")
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "/workspaces/hack2-fall26_Team_15/buils/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-2Crpxv")
add_executable(cmTC_09ca4)
target_sources(cmTC_09ca4 PRIVATE
  "/workspaces/hack2-fall26_Team_15/buils/CMakeFiles/CMakeScratch/TryCompile-2Crpxv/CheckFunctionExists.c"
)
file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/cmTC_09ca4_loc"
     CONTENT $<TARGET_FILE:cmTC_09ca4>)
set_property(TARGET cmTC_09ca4 PROPERTY "C_STANDARD" "99")
target_link_libraries(cmTC_09ca4 ${LINK_LIBRARIES})
